title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
task: Long-horizon task execution with explicit state management for LLM agents
key_results: Improves Qwen 3.7-Plus from 51.8% to 80.7% on WeaveBench, 69.7% to 77.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 2.8% to 8.3% on OSWorld 2.0
comments: Manage-Execute-Audit loop addresses a fundamental issue (context growth and state tracking), but gains diminish on more complex domains like OSWorld, suggesting inherent difficulty limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit state management outside execution context reduces error propagation in long-horizon tasks
hypotheses.result: Consistent improvements across models and benchmarks; gains larger on simpler tasks

title: SwanTale: Unified Multi-Speaker Speech and Audio Generation for Instruct and Zero-Shot Tasks
task: Multi-speaker expressive speech and audio generation for instruct and zero-shot tasks
key_results: SwanTale achieves best expressiveness scores on both zero-shot and instruct metrics; supports complex multi-speaker speech and audio generation
comments: Comprehensive dataset curation (SwanData-Caption) and architectural innovations (SwanVAE, Unified MoE) enable strong multi-modal generation, though generalization beyond trained domains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Instruction-based generation with captions improves controllability over zero-shot approaches
hypotheses.result: Both zero-shot and instruct tasks show comparable expressiveness; instruct enables more fine-grained control

title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
task: Mitigating privilege illusion in on-policy self-distillation via dual-anchored policy alignment
key_results: DAPD outperforms OPSD by +2.00 points on Qwen3-4B; gains persist at scale reaching +2.78 at 32B
comments: Identifies and addresses a subtle but important failure mode in distillation (privilege-dependent behavior), though the practical impact on real applications remains to be demonstrated.

outputs: refined student policy with reduced privilege dependence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Information asymmetry between privileged teacher and inference-time student causes degradation
hypotheses.result: Dual-anchored alignment addressing both reference-to-rollout and rollout-to-reference directions resolves asymmetry

title: Progressive Agent Skill Generation via Reinforcement Learning
task: Progressive high-quality agent skill generation via reinforcement learning
key_results: Skill-α improves average downstream success rates by +3.3 points on CL-Bench and +6.7 points on tau2-bench over strongest baseline
comments: Rollback reward mechanism elegantly evaluates skill edits by comparing execution outcomes; sequential editing formulation is more interpretable than end-to-end synthesis.

outputs: high-quality agent skill with verified edits

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sequential edit-based skill construction with rollback rewards produces more effective skills than heuristic pipelines
hypotheses.result: Verified improvements on document-to-skill and experience-to-skill settings; rollback reward crucial for edit evaluation

title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
task: Attributing visual evidence in multimodal on-policy distillation to improve student supervision
key_results: VAD outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting across six fine-grained visual benchmarks; token-level analysis shows proxy-aligned component enriched in task-relevant corrections
comments: Counterfactual target reconstruction via intervention-aligned projections is theoretically motivated; however, computational overhead of counterfactual evaluation not discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Isolating visually attributable corrections via counterfactual evidence removal improves distillation targets
hypotheses.result: Proxy-aligned components yield stronger target shifts; especially effective when evidence refutes mistaken answers

title: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
task: Evaluating world models across visual quality, control adherence, spatial consistency, and inherent world reactivity
key_results: Hierarchical benchmark with 1,474 cases across eight tasks; reveals capability split: camera-driven models excel at control, action-driven precise subject control, language-driven better at interaction
comments: WorldExam's focus on inherent reactivity (beyond explicit instructions) addresses an important evaluation gap; however, the benchmark may be gated behind specific model implementations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different paradigms (camera-, action-, language-driven) have complementary strengths and weaknesses in world modeling
hypotheses.result: No model achieves broad task coverage with consistently strong performance; high visual quality and instruction fulfillment do not guarantee reactivity

title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
task: Unified sparse and dense multimodal embeddings for retrieval and RAG
key_results: UEmbed-9B reaches 71.8 (dense) and 71.0 (sparse) on MMEB-v2, outperforming public multimodal embedding models; competitive on BEIR; decoder-only single-pass generation
comments: Novel decoder-only design unifying sparse and dense embeddings is elegant; practical gains in RAG pipelines could be better characterized with downstream task measurements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoder-only architecture can efficiently produce both sparse and dense embeddings in one causal pass
hypotheses.result: Achieves competitive performance on MMEB-v2 and BEIR with public-data training; scales to 2B, 4B, 9B

title: CADENA: Stepwise CAD Reverse Engineering
task: CAD reverse engineering via stepwise parametric program reconstruction
key_results: CADENA outperforms prior methods on CADENA-Bench, DeepCAD, Fusion 360, and MCB datasets; stepwise geometry comparison improves reconstruction accuracy
comments: Step-by-step program generation with intermediate geometry verification mirrors human engineering workflow; benchmark addresses real evaluation gap for CAD recovery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stepwise CAD construction with intermediate geometry comparison improves program generation accuracy
hypotheses.result: Outperforms end-to-end single-pass methods on multiple mechanical part datasets

title: Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for Verifiable Reasoning in Autonomous Driving VLMs
task: Verifiable reasoning in autonomous driving VLMs via deferred trajectory exposure
key_results: DEFT-RLVR eliminates trajectory anchoring bias; AD-MCQ provides scalable verification framework; improves VLM reasoning while preserving general visual capabilities
comments: Addresses subtle but important reasoning bias (post-hoc rationalization) in CoT supervision; AD-MCQ formulation clever but may limit reasoning expressiveness compared to open-ended generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exposing ground-truth trajectories during teacher supervision induces trajectory anchoring bias in CoT generation
hypotheses.result: Removing GT trajectory with AD-MCQ formulation reduces hallucinations and produces more causally faithful reasoning

title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
task: Verified synthetic data generation for skill-use training in language-model agents
key_results: SKT produces 4,000 task packages and 27,164 verified trajectories from 2,000 skills; SFT on SKT-generated data consistently improves skill-use performance across models and benchmarks
comments: Verification pipeline (rule-based and agent-based with feedback-guided repair) ensures high-quality supervision; scalability to arbitrary skill repositories demonstrated.

outputs: verified skill-grounded tasks and executable trajectories

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-quality verified supervision via synthetic data improves skill-use capabilities at scale
hypotheses.result: Consistent improvements across diverse models, benchmarks, and harnesses; gains scale with broader skill coverage

title: SWE-Touch: Benchmarking Coding Agents When Users Touch the Code
task: Evaluating coding agents in shared workspaces with user-initiated code edits
key_results: Counter-Edit lowers average resolve rate by 7.7 percentage points on SWE-bench Verified; degradation persists on longer-horizon benchmarks; agents struggle with workspace awareness and verification
comments: SWE-Touch identifies realistic failure modes in agent systems; counter-edits test adaptive behavior but may underrepresent intentional human guidance beyond code changes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plausible counter-edits conflicting with task completion degrade agent performance due to limited workspace awareness
hypotheses.result: Agents retain conflicting code or replace it without sufficiently re-inspecting repository; targeted testing reveals need for better state reconciliation

title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
task: Vision-Language-Action RL for robotic manipulation via explicit world state modeling in critic
key_results: WCM achieves state-of-the-art on 149 tasks across four benchmarks; particularly strong generalization gains; validates on seven real-world manipulation tasks
comments: Joint latent state prediction and value estimation elegantly addresses temporal structure limitation; LeJEPA-based critic design shows value of explicit world modeling over pure scalar regression.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit world modeling in the critic captures temporal dynamics needed for accurate value estimation in partially observable robotic control
hypotheses.result: Joint future-state and value prediction outperforms scalar-return regression; consistent gains on in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings

title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
task: Test-time latent reasoning via credit-assigned gradient flow through transformer circuit
key_results: GradCuit achieves 64.5% average accuracy, +6.6pp over CoT, +2.4pp over LatentSeek; robust across seven learning-rate settings; layer analysis identifies early-to-middle transformer as optimal optimization space
comments: Direct causal path from latent states to continuation token probabilities via self-attention enables stronger credit assignment than token-level decoding; interpretability analysis valuable.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimizing internal latent states at transformer layer via reward-weighted gradients improves reasoning robustness
hypotheses.result: Outperforms token-level methods and CoT; consistent gains across backbones and reasoning benchmarks; layer attribution reveals optimal optimization depth

title: Motion Beyond Morphology: Bootstrapping Cross-Category Motion Transfer from Abstract Motion Representations
task: Cross-category video motion transfer via abstract motion representations
key_results: State-of-the-art motion fidelity and target preservation across morphology gaps (Same, Near, Far); bootstrap approach enables training on cross-category pairs without explicit structure correspondence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transferable motion dynamics can be preserved across different morphologies via abstract motion views
hypotheses.result: Bootstrap cross-category pairs from complementary multi-granularity views; direct conditioning removes inference-time motion extraction

title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
task: High-speed text generation via parallel discrete diffusion refinement
key_results: DiffusionGemma generates ~20 tokens per forward pass at ~1,500 tokens/sec on single H100; establishes new Pareto frontier for speed-capability trade-off; retains thinking mode and multimodal support
comments: Compute-efficient two-stage training (SFT + RL+sampler-distillation) uses <10% of AR model's tokens; bidirectional denoising enables parallel refinement, but generation quality vs. AR models not directly compared.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete diffusion with parallel token refinement avoids AR sequential bottleneck while maintaining capability
hypotheses.result: 20 tokens per pass with strong speed gains; retains multimodal and reasoning capabilities; viable alternative to speculative decoding

title: GPTQ-2D: Cubic-Time Two-Sided Adaptive Rounding
task: Cubic-time two-sided adaptive rounding for matrix quantization
key_results: GPTQ-2D produces identical rounded matrix to quartic one-sided algorithm in cubic time; vectorizes problem via Kronecker product structure with anti-diagonal processing
comments: Elegant algorithmic improvement with direct applicability to quantized model optimization; limited to matrix rounding but mathematical insight may inspire similar reductions elsewhere.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anti-diagonal processing of two-sided rounding achieves cubic rather than quartic complexity
hypotheses.result: Produces identical results to vectorized approach with improved computational efficiency

title: Roomer: Reflective Object-Grounded Model Editing and Repair for 3D Indoor Layout Synthesis
task: Local repair of invalid 3D indoor layouts via object-grounded violation identification and reflective planning
key_results: Roomer repairs residual violations while preserving valid regions; improves physical validity and usability compared to full-scene synthesis; introduces Roomer-Eval for practical usability assessment
comments: Object-grounded repair approach more practical than full-scene regeneration; controlled-corruption dataset (Roomer-CC) well-motivated for supervision; verification step validates repairs without broken constraints.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Object-grounded violation repair with geometry-conditioned planning preserves scene validity
hypotheses.result: Successfully repairs collisions, out-of-bounds, obstructed openings, and circulation issues; deterministic validation ensures no new violations introduced

title: DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
task: Long-horizon multimodal deep-search with vision-in-the-loop intermediate reasoning
key_results: DeepVoyager-VL improves across ten multimodal search benchmarks; incorporates visual evidence at intermediate reasoning steps rather than only input/output; synthesizes problems with visual dependencies
comments: Multimodal event graph drives data synthesis effectively; vision-in-the-loop framework addresses gap in prior methods that confined vision to periphery; cross-benchmark improvements suggest generality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intermediate visual evidence drives continued retrieval better than vision only at input/output stages
hypotheses.result: Data synthesis via multimodal event graph + active visual acquisition improves depth and reasoning span across benchmarks

title: 3DZip: Spatial-Aware Feature Diversity-Guided Token Compression for 3D Question Answering
task: Token compression for 3D question answering via spatial-aware feature diversity
key_results: 3DZip retains 94.7% of original performance with only 128 tokens (1.92x faster inference); outperforms attention-based and semantic-relevance compression; three-stage framework (voxelization, DPP selection, spatial merging)
comments: DPP-based anchor selection captures feature-space diversity better than attention; spatial merging under geometric constraints preserves 3D structure; applicable to other 3D vision tasks.

inputs: projected 3D point features in world coordinates
outputs: compressed token set preserving geometric structure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial-aware compression via DPP selection preserves performance better than attention-based methods for 3D tokens
hypotheses.result: 94.7% performance retention with 128 tokens; three-stage design handles point-level and object-level redundancy separately

title: To Add Is Machine, To Delete Is Human: Measuring and Mitigating Deletion Avoidance in LLM Code Editing
task: Measuring and mitigating deletion avoidance in LLM code editing
key_results: Deletion recall maxes at 71.7% across leading models; retrofitting tests with deletion checks drops performance from 63.2% to 41.9%; teaching deletion in post-training recovers 80.5% success
comments: The Guard-and-Go pattern reveals a fundamental training gap rather than capability ceiling, but even with targeted fixes, deletion remains harder than addition for LLMs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models systematically avoid deleting code even when patches require removal

hypotheses.hypothesis: Providing exact line spans helps deletion performance
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; nearly eliminates incomplete deletion but only raises success to 80.5% due to over-deletion and substitution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deletion avoidance is undertrained rather than incapable
hypotheses.result: Supported; post-training interventions reduce avoidance and improve code-editing performance

title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
task: Single-step real-time talking-head generation with temporal stability via Brownian bridge distillation
key_results: LeapTalk achieves high-fidelity generation at up to 200 FPS with single forward step; data-to-data Brownian bridge transport maintains identity consistency; outperforms multi-step diffusion and AR approaches
comments: Novel bridge-distillation scheme elegantly transfers teacher knowledge while enabling single-step inference; SNR-aligned time transformation resolves functional mismatch; audio-driven guidance maintains lip-sync.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Data-to-data Brownian bridge transport with persistent reference enables stable single-step generation
hypotheses.result: Mitigates identity drift and enhances temporal stability; SNR-aligned distillation enables knowledge transfer from diffusion teacher

title: StyleForge: Indoor Furniture Styling by Counterfactual Reasoning in a Hypergraph Field
task: Indoor furniture styling via counterfactual reasoning in dynamic hypergraph style field
key_results: State-of-the-art furniture retrieval and scene-level style coherence; dynamic hypergraph field captures higher-order dependencies; test-time training progressively corrects cross-slot conflicts
comments: Counterfactual style-preference learning via Mahalanobis energies elegantly evaluates candidate compatibility; frozen multimodal LLM extracts style priors; higher-order hyperedges capture multi-furniture interactions.

outputs: selected furniture per slot with coherent style

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic hypergraph style field with counterfactual candidate evaluation preserves scene-level style coherence
hypotheses.result: Higher-order dependencies captured better than object-level retrieval; test-time training adapts to room-specific context

title: DreamTraj: Generating 6-DoF Object Trajectories by Reading Unrendered Video Diffusion Latents
task: 6-DoF object trajectory prediction from diffusion model latents without rendered video
key_results: DreamTraj sets state-of-the-art on translation and rotation against forecasters with multi-frame or privileged inputs; 4.6x faster than generate-then-extract pipelines; no video, depth, or CAD required
comments: Novel insight: reading motion from intermediate diffusion representations rather than generated pixels avoids perception pipeline errors; MOVE dataset provides fine-grained language-to-motion annotation gap closure.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Object 6-DoF trajectories can be decoded from intermediate video diffusion representations rather than generated pixels
hypotheses.result: Avoids costly perception pipeline; flow-matching reader on query-key attention tracks yields SOTA results with faster inference

title: Poplar: A Scalable Pipeline for Human-Centric Image Dataset Synthesis
task: Scalable human-centric image dataset synthesis via specify-render-inspect pipeline
key_results: Poplar produces Poplar-9K: 9,401 curated human-centric pairs (79.9% acceptance rate); reproducible pipeline with immutable generation prompts and auditable inspection records
comments: Specify-Render-Inspect pipeline is elegant and reproducible; structured vision-language review preserves photographic character while rejecting defects; release includes dataset, pipeline, and configurations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured attribute specification with commonsense constraints and visual-language review produces coherent large-scale human datasets
hypotheses.result: 79.9% acceptance rate with coverage of varied people/contexts; photographic character preserved; scalable to customizable collections

title: ScrambleToolBench: Agents Search Exhaustively Even When Their Own Map Points to the Next Step
task: Benchmarking agent behavior discovery via trial-and-error in terminal environment with mapping drift
key_results: ScrambleToolBench reveals that successful initial discovery does not ensure adaptation under structural changes; agents exhibit belief inertia and exhaust search despite mapping drift; test-time reasoning amplifies brute-force search
comments: Removes semantic cues and enforces continuous curriculum to isolate behavioral reasoning; dynamic challenges (mapping drift, stochastic failures, temporal windows) reveal important agent limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents struggle with deductive recovery from structural changes and instead fall back to exhaustive search despite reasoning capability
hypotheses.result: Belief inertia persists; test-time reasoning amplifies expensive brute-force search rather than enabling efficient deduction

title: Model or Harness? An Interaction-Centric Taxonomy for Localizing Agent Failures
task: Localizing agent failures via interaction-centric taxonomy mapping failures to responsible components
key_results: 41 failure modes organized by interaction edge and fault side; taxonomy applies across agent architectures; independent reasoning agents judge labels at κ=0.76 against human labels
comments: Interaction-centric perspective shifts from outcome-level to component-level accountability; actionable structure enables targeted interventions (post-training, harness engineering, environment redesign); grounded in real benchmarks and logs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Localizing failures to component interactions rather than system outcomes enables targeted repair interventions
hypotheses.result: 41 failure modes consistently characterized; taxonomy scales across architectures; judges reach κ=0.76 reproducibility

title: Relax Within, Balance Across: Geometry-Guided Load Balancing for Vision-Language Mixture-of-Experts
task: Load balancing in Vision-Language MoE via geometry-guided routing across image-text token mixes
key_results: ReBA (Relax Within, Balance Across) lowers load imbalance across all tested benchmarks while maintaining accuracy; handles 5x variation in load imbalance across image resolutions; separate image and text routing
comments: Identifies and fixes limitation of token-level auxiliary loss that allows cancellation of large image/text errors; geometry-guided design reflects token structure; practical efficiency gains demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Separate image and text routing with equal-weight per-image instances balances load across variable token mixes
hypotheses.result: Lowers load imbalance on every benchmark; maintains accuracy; handles resolution and tiling shifts

title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
task: Automated recommender system optimization via bandit-routed agentic harness with self-evolution
key_results: RecHarness outperforms LLM-reasoning search for stable performance; 7-day online A/B test: +2.084% ADVV, +0.534% Revenue, +0.559% Exposure on short-video advertising platform
comments: Bandit router + LLM hypothesis generation decouples direction selection from concrete edit generation; jump-basin mechanism prevents stagnation; demonstrable real-world deployment gains.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bandit-routed selection of modification directions with LLM-generated hypotheses enables stable automated recommender optimization
hypotheses.result: More stable than LLM-only reasoning; jump-basin activation prevents local optima; verified gains on production system

title: ICDAR 2026 Competition on Information Extraction from Atomic Layer Deposition/Etching (ALD/E) Scientific Figures
task: Information extraction from ALD/E scientific figures with multimodal AI

key_results: Semantic materialization: retained events act as independently servable views; deliberately phrased answer-free events recover 51% correctness vs. 6% baseline; compact state survives, large payloads decay
comments: Identifies fundamental principle: what event-KV rows carry depends on both content and phrasing; passive harvesting yields no advantage; implications for cache eviction and episodic memory design in agents.
